source: Activity templates for N5 lessons. Each template uses the lesson's items of one content type. Placeholders: {lesson}, {count}.

en.title: Recognize the words of {lesson}
en.objective: Recognize the {count} words of this lesson and connect each one to its meaning.
en.instruction: Choose the meaning of the word.
en.explanation: Recognizing a word comes before using it: here you connect what you see with what it means.

id.title: Kenali kosakata {lesson}
id.objective: Mengenali {count} kosakata pelajaran ini dan menghubungkan masing-masing dengan maknanya.
id.explanation: Mengenali kata adalah langkah sebelum menggunakannya: di sini Anda menghubungkan apa yang Anda lihat dengan maknanya.

en.title: Recall the words of {lesson}
en.objective: Given its meaning, recall each of the {count} words of this lesson and type it, without answer choices.
en.instruction: Type the Japanese word in kana or romaji.
en.explanation: Producing a word from its meaning is harder than recognizing it, and that effort is what makes it stick.

id.title: Ingat kosakata {lesson}
id.objective: Berdasarkan artinya, mengingat dan mengetik {count} kosakata pelajaran ini tanpa pilihan jawaban.
id.instruction: Ketik kata bahasa Jepangnya dalam kana atau romaji.
id.explanation: Menghasilkan kata dari artinya lebih sulit daripada mengenalinya, dan usaha itulah yang membuatnya melekat.

en.title: Build sentences for {lesson}
en.objective: Build the {count} sentences of this lesson in correct Japanese word order, using the lesson's grammar patterns.
en.instruction: Arrange the pieces to say the sentence in Japanese.
en.explanation: Ordering words and particles yourself is controlled practice: the step between understanding a pattern and using it freely.

id.title: Susun kalimat {lesson}
id.objective: Menyusun {count} kalimat pelajaran ini dengan urutan kata bahasa Jepang yang benar, menggunakan pola tata bahasa pelajaran ini.
id.instruction: Susun potongan-potongan berikut menjadi kalimat bahasa Jepang.
id.explanation: Menyusun kata dan partikel sendiri adalah latihan terkontrol: langkah antara memahami pola dan menggunakannya dengan bebas.

en.title: Read the sentences of {lesson}
en.objective: Read the {count} sentences of this lesson and say what each one means.
en.instruction: Read the Japanese sentence, then choose its meaning.
en.explanation: Reading a whole sentence checks that you can use the words and patterns together, not only one at a time.

id.title: Baca kalimat {lesson}
id.objective: Membaca {count} kalimat pelajaran ini dan menyebutkan artinya.
id.instruction: Baca kalimat bahasa Jepang, lalu pilih artinya.
id.explanation: Membaca kalimat utuh memeriksa apakah Anda dapat memakai kata dan pola bersama-sama, bukan satu per satu.

en.title: Listen to the sentences of {lesson}
en.objective: Understand the {count} sentences of this lesson when you hear them, without seeing them.
en.instruction: Listen to the sentence, then choose its meaning.
en.explanation: Hearing a sentence without the text is what real conversation is like: you connect sound and meaning directly.

id.title: Simak kalimat {lesson}
id.objective: Memahami {count} kalimat pelajaran ini saat mendengarnya, tanpa melihat teksnya.
id.explanation: Mendengar kalimat tanpa teks seperti percakapan sungguhan: Anda menghubungkan bunyi dengan makna secara langsung.
